selection_rule: No model, checkpoint, preference profile, seed, or candidate may be changed after external-evidence access.
low_frequency_novel_definition: MutationPatientCount between 2 and 18 inclusive and Gene not in Train union Validation labels.
internal_evidence_role: EvidenceScore ranking baseline and confounding/correlation audit only.

external_evidence_definitions.frozen_literature_holdout: Membership in the pre-existing 16-gene rare RCC holdout frozen on 2026-07-16.
external_evidence_definitions.cptac_recurrence: At least 2 mutated tumors in the independent CPTAC ccRCC cohort.
external_evidence_definitions.cptac_protein_support: At least 20 matched tumor-normal pairs, absolute median paired protein-abundance difference >= 1 log2 unit, and two-sided paired Wilcoxon BH-FDR < 0.05.
external_evidence_definitions.depmap_ccrcc_dependency: At least 5 measured ccRCC models and median Chronos gene effect <= -0.5.
external_evidence_definitions.depmap_ccrcc_selective_dependency: DepMap ccRCC dependency plus non-kidney median minus ccRCC median >= 0.25.
external_evidence_definitions.independent_any_hit: Frozen literature holdout OR CPTAC recurrence OR CPTAC protein support OR DepMap ccRCC selective dependency.
external_evidence_definitions.independent_strong_hit: At least two of the four independent evidence classes above.

baseline_definitions.EvidenceScore: LowFrequencyEvidenceScoreV2 descending; internal/oracle-like baseline, never an external outcome.
baseline_definitions.GRN_degree: GRN total degree descending; post-hoc confounder, not an input to the latest bandit.
baseline_definitions.MLP_GCN: Existing fixed final rankings; no retraining. Seeds 42/45/46.
baseline_definitions.bandit: Frozen greedy-rollout Top-150 for seeds 42/45/48 and three fixed profiles.

primary_metrics: candidate-pool-restricted Top-K low-frequency independent-evidence hit rate at K
fold enrichment versus the low-frequency novel pool
mean pairwise Top-K Jaccard across seeds

ranking_scopes.primary: Restrict every full ranking to the same low-frequency novel pool, then take K. This gives every method exactly K candidates.
ranking_scopes.secondary: Take the global Top-K first and then retain low-frequency novel genes. This matches the historical Discovery metric but can unfairly penalize mutation ranking because high-frequency genes consume slots.

comparison_rule: Bandit is retained only if the conclusion is stable across its three seeds and it exceeds the direct EvidenceScore and degree baselines; unmatched 3-seed comparisons with MLP/GCN are descriptive, with paired seed comparison restricted to 42 and 45.

simple_reordering_diagnostic.interpretation: Heuristic diagnostic only, not a statistical proof of identity.
